name: Richardshhhon 2026

venue.name: The University of Texas at Dallas - SCI 2.235

information: ##### This is not a normal competition with common events like 3x3 and 2x2. This competition features quiet events only. For a more normal competition experience, check out the [many other competitions happening in Texas](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=USA&search=Texas&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&show_registration_status=on&display=list). The University of Texas at Dallas and the Comet Cubing Club will not take custodial responsibility of minors while participating in Richardshhhon 2026. Custodial responsibility will remain with teachers K-12, parents, legal guardians, and chaperones. This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjUxMzcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9863833688a5f44433b5f4dc6d8a75f973072f10/southernCubing%203-01.png)
